channel.title: Said & Checked: Banking and Finance — AskAmerica
channel.description: What officeholders said each day about Banking and Finance, and which statements government data supports, contradicts or rules out.

item.title: Said & Checked, Banking and Finance, 2026-11-20: 1 contradicted (Steny Hoyer)
item.description:
False or contradicted

  • Steny Hoyer, U.S. Representative: “In 2013, I helped a group of Democrats and Republicans to reauthorize the Export-Import Bank, over the objections of the chairman of the Financial Services Committee, who was a Republican.” Contradicted. AskAmerica's bill records show Export-Import Bank reauthorizations enacted in 2012 (H.R. 2072, P.L. 112-122) and passed by the House in October 2015 (H.R. 597, 313-118, after a discharge motion), while 2013 Ex-Im bills were only referred to committee; the 2015 bill's text amends the 2012 act, with no 2013 act between them. Hoyer's own role and the chairman's opposition were not assessed, and the warehouse holds no 2013 House roll calls, so a 2013 vote under another title is not fully ruled out.

item.title: Said & Checked, Banking and Finance, 2026-11-15: none false or contradicted, 1 unsupported (Mike Pence)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsupported

  • Mike Pence, Former Vice President of the United States: “And the fact that, that a large portion of the source of that, before the inauguration, came from foreign interests in the Arab world.” Unsupported. No financial disclosure or official record was found showing what share of the family's cryptocurrency proceeds before the inauguration came from investors in Arab countries. The search covered token sales before the inauguration, a $2 billion deal with an Abu Dhabi firm that was announced after it, and the warehouse catalog; a Reuters report could not be read.
